_about: Settings that were actually decided for flying. live_follow.py compares what is about to run against this file at startup and STOPS on any difference unless --off-decisions is passed; the result is saved in every flight's drone.json. replay.py runs the same check against the same file (Michael 11-26: replay always matches what we fly unless he says otherwise) and saves the result in replay_info.json. Only settings with a recorded decision belong here (code comment, README change log or commit). skip_with: the modes in which a check cannot apply (--fake-detector: no real detector; --fake: no real drone; replay: replay.py, which never talks to a drone).

detector_model.source: Michael 11-22: fly the INT8 detector, stop if missing (README change log 2026-11-22; commits aae2f0f, 29b47ec; INT8_MODEL comment in live_follow.py). Path is relative to followme/.

detector_int8.source: Michael 11-22: INT8 OpenVINO, measured 10-29 at ~3x faster than the .pt for -0.01 F1 (README change log 2026-11-22; commit aae2f0f).

detection_cutoffs.source: Michael 11-26: fly at the per-class F1-max cutoffs from thresholds_balanced.py, read from the evidence file, not set by hand (README change log 2026-11-26; commit f36ad29). Michael 11-26 (later): rerun the sweep on the INT8 export itself and fly the measured INT8 cutoffs, so the flight model's cutoffs come from this file's vd_mav_cl_s42_int8 entry (person 0.23, vehicle 0.29; curves in results/followme_thresholds_balanced_int8.json), not from the .pt entry in results/followme_cutoffs_balanced.json (0.24 / 0.28). The Oct 29 note that INT8 kept the .pt's best cutoffs was wrong. Path is relative to the repo root; it is the file live_follow.cutoffs_file_for() picks for the INT8 model.

tracker.source: Tracker benchmark (followme_tracker_comparison_v5, Ultralytics 8.4.184 built-in trackers, TrackEval; results/followme_tracker_scores.jsonl, byte-exact from Drive): with the flight detector vd_mav_cl_s42, BoT-SORT with camera-motion compensation and tracker re-ID off ('botsort|reid-|gmc+' = Ultralytics' default botsort.yaml) has the highest class-average HOTA on all four sets: VisDrone-MOT val 0.2658, test-dev 0.2927, MOT17 train 0.3946, MOT20 train 0.3173 (MOT17/MOT20: 5 configs each; runner-up 0.2641 BoT-SORT+re-ID, 0.2907 BoT-SORT+re-ID, 0.3850, 0.3163). Person-only HOTA on VisDrone is higher with tracker re-ID (val: Deep OC-SORT+re-ID+GMC 0.3276 vs 0.3162; test-dev: BoT-SORT+re-ID+GMC 0.2738 vs 0.2692) at ~270 vs ~21-30 ms/frame and more ID switches; re-ID was rejected for that (11-15). Michael 11-26: keep it. Flown on every flight (never overridden in a run command).

imgsz.source: Michael 11-26: 'if that's what we've been doing this whole time then that's fine'. 640 is live_follow's default since the first version (ce5675a, and the Downloads copy before it) and no flight command passed --imgsz; the detector was trained, F1-swept (thresholds_balanced.py) and tracker-benchmarked at 640.

reid.source: Michael 11-22: OSNet re-ID, stop if it can't load, no histogram fallback (README change log 2026-11-22; commit 29b47ec; lockon.make_embedder docstring).

match_sim.source: Michael 11-21: keep the re-ID re-lock cutoff at 0.70, chosen by judgment among measured options (lockon.MATCH_SIM, read from results/followme_reid_cutoff.json; commit 0f86828; README 'Search (Michael 2026-11-21)'). Evidence: results/followme_reid_bench_v3.json + followme_reid_scores_osnet_x0_25.npz (OSNet x0_25 ROC-AUC 0.9652; 8.1% of single stranger looks pass at 0.70, 1% at 0.789) and the 10-29 replay at 0.65-0.85 (results/followme_reid_replay_1029*.json: no wrong re-lock at any cutoff; at 0.79 lost for ~2.5 min). test_reid_evidence.py checks the record against them.

drone_profile_applied.source: Michael 11-22: push drone_profile.json on every connect; can't apply -> stop (README change log 2026-11-22; commits ba12485, 29b47ec).

click_to_lock.source: Michael 11-20: lock only on a click, never an automatic 'biggest person' (lockon.py docstring 'Lock rule (Michael 2026-11-20)'; README 'Lock-on behavior'). --auto-lock is for the fake-drone test only.

search_deg.source: Michael 2026-11-14: 'a 360 relatively quickly' (SEARCH_YAW / SEARCH_DEG comments in live_follow.py).

search_both_ways.source: Michael 2026-11-14: spin toward the side last seen, then the other way, then hover (SEARCH_BOTH comment in live_follow.py).

lost_s.source: Michael 11-26: 'We can keep the 1 second spin': after the target is lost, hover LOST_S = 1.0 s (the tracker often gets them back under the same ID), then start the 360 search. Value unchanged since the code was first committed (ce5675a, replay.LOST_S; now live_follow.LOST_S).
